description: Model 2 Emulator (ElSemi). EMULATOR.INI [Input] keys are set from 'ini'. Per-game CFG\<rom>.input files are an undocumented binary format (one little-endian DWORD per control; observed: high byte 0x01 = joystick 1, 0x11 = joystick 1 axis variant, low byte 0x00-0x0B axes, 0x0C-0x0F hat, 0xN0 = button N; keyboard = DIK scan code) - they are copied from the previous owner's reference set unchanged and are only valid while the wheel is DirectInput device #1. Re-bind inside the emulator (Game > Configure Controls) for any other layout.

games.daytona: Daytona USA - 4-speed H or VR buttons; FFB via m2 (EnableFF=1) or FFBPlugin.
games.srallyc: Sega Rally Championship - 4-speed, handbrake not supported.
